title: Special Topics in French Studies; Borders, Exile, and War in the Mashrek: Representations in Literature, Film, and Media of the Francophone Middle East
description:
Cross-listed with ARAB499F. Credit only granted for FREN499M or ARAB499F.

Explores selected films and francophone texts in translation from various genres (plays, essays, novels, poetry) with a focus on the concepts of borders, exile, and war from and on the Middle East. Taught in English.
